purpose: Bind each reviewed lexical pronunciation to an independent Wikimedia Commons recording while preserving stable word and sense identities.

review.reviewerRole: R&D implementation review under the product-owner feature request
review.authorizationBasis: The product owner explicitly requested real recordings for every available lexical pronunciation in the current R&D task.
review.scope: Pronunciation-to-sense audio bindings with explicit IPA/POS evidence; explicitly unresolved recordings are excluded.

source.selectionRule: One recording per distinct reviewed lexical pronunciation; prefer a matching part of speech and US recording when available; never reuse one pronunciation as another.
